question: In an AL extension, where and how should an API credential for calling an external HTTP API be stored and handled when a setup page captures it?
answer: Per microsoft/knowledge/security/secrets-isolated-storage.md, an API key or token must not be stored in an ordinary table Text field, not even on a hidden setup table; persist it in IsolatedStorage, written at the point of capture and read only when needed. Per microsoft/knowledge/security/isolatedstorage-setencrypted-for-sensitive-values.md, use the SecretText overloads of IsolatedStorage.SetEncrypted and IsolatedStorage.Get for secrets; encrypted values are subject to a documented storage-size limit. Per microsoft/knowledge/security/secrettext-for-credentials.md, carry the credential as SecretText from retrieval to the consuming call and do not round-trip it through Text. Conditions: the last two articles apply from BC 23 and BC 24 respectively, and the target BC version is unknown, so they are conditional on bc-version. The authentication scheme was not supplied and is not answered here.
